reference.source: Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics 22nd Edition Vol 1+2 (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Age-cutoff fast breathing with indrawing-danger triages while viral-wheeze versus bacterial-fever sorts pneumonia for first-line amoxicillin with PCV-Hib cover; RSV bronchiolitis takes suction-oxygen with bronchodilator restraint, and bark-steeple croup takes single dexamethasone with adrenaline rescue.
additionalDifferentials: Pneumonia versus bronchiolitis versus croup by wheeze bark and age
Viral versus bacterial versus atypical by fever x-ray and age
Croup versus epiglottitis versus foreign by drool and onset
